health.shortComment: Mahomes completed 27 of 39 passes for 324 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
health.longComment: Mahomes was clicking early against the Cardinals' defense, capping off the opening possession of the game with an eight-yard touchdown toss to Travis Kelce. The prolific signal-caller went on to add a 22-yard scoring pass to Kelce shortly before the end of the first half, and he capped off his day with an 18-yarder to Xavier Worthy on which the speedy receiver raced up the right sideline and into the end zone. Mahomes now has consecutive 300-yard efforts and has accomplished the feat in three of the past four games overall, affording him plenty of momentum heading into a Week 12 showdown with Josh Allen and the Bills on Thanksgiving night.
